title: Supplementary flaw remediation requires dated release and update records
remediation: The sponsor vulnerability and service owners approve how flaws are identified, reported and corrected, and set the time allowed from release to installation of security-relevant software and firmware updates. Sample a flaw through closure and compare release and installation dates against the approved limit for assessed components. Record supplier evidence as a supporting reference and explain any unresolved overdue exposure.

milestones.title: Collect the approved remediation and update policy, one redacted closed flaw record and representative software and firmware release-to-installation timestamps
